description: Contract families whose JSON Schema in /schemas is the canonical authority. Generated TypeScript lives in packages/contracts/generated and Ajv validators are exported from @app-builder/contracts. Run `npm run contracts:generate` after editing any listed schema; `npm run contracts:check` fails when generated output drifts from the recorded hash.

families.boundary: Service project creation, generator input and manifest file reads.
Reviewed intake handoff into the factory.
Exported intake bundles and resumed intake drafts.
Content-intelligence output, service ingestion and composition input.
Composer output and generated .app-builder/composition.json reads.
Durable control-plane task records.
Build/Event Ledger records and service event reads.
Durable checkpoints and fresh-session resume packets.
Declared autonomous mutation scope.
Human content edits stored by the service and applied over a deterministic composition.
Builder Element Identity derived at generation time, written beside the composition and resolved by the service before any direct-manipulation edit.
Browser captures of what a build renders, written by the service and read by the Console.
Per-asset publication decisions recorded by the service and replayed into composition.
Presentation choices stored by the service and replayed over a deterministic composition.
Structured design decisions stored by the service and compiled into the generated project's brand tokens.
Durable approved-intake persistence and the service replay/import path.
Explicitly approved immutable project-generation state and the single-use approved-plan execution boundary.
Phase 4D candidate generation, comparison and promotion; written by the factory service and read by the Console.
Design references a person supplied, analysed into adopt/avoid traits; written by the factory service, read by the Console and by visual-direction selection.
One bounded, targeted revision of one visual candidate; written by the factory service when an independent review returns a candidate for rework.

The one lifecycle a candidate product travels, from an approved contract to a production-verified deploy. Written by the control-plane lifecycle reducer and read by the service and Console wherever readiness is stated.
Permission for one exact operation against one exact base, once. Minted by the service on explicit operator approval and required by every mutating route.
What the service says about a project over its own boundary. Written by the service and read by the Console, which used to carry a hand-written copy of it.
What pages exist and why, decided from approved truth before any presentation choice. Read by composition; the artifact config/agent-roles.json calls InformationArchitectureSpec.

A fulfilment is produced and bounded by tooling/lib/bespoke-presentation.mjs and validated by tooling/bespoke-presentation.test.mjs. It becomes a contract family when the Console reads one — nothing does yet, and generating types for a boundary with no second side is a type nobody imports.

Governance records for capabilities nothing executes yet. It becomes a contract family when a media, extraction or behaviour-evidence adapter actually resolves against it; generating types for a boundary with no second side is a type nobody imports.

Inlined into the composition family.

The external knowledge/skill source registry is governance documentation until a runtime resolves against it.
Validated directly by the acceptance evidence validator and still written against JSON Schema draft-07; migrate the dialect before adopting it as a runtime family.
Inlined into the intake-session family.
